opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, femme speaking. now can I help?
opening.comment: The greeting gives the company name but not the agent's own name (it appears garbled as 'femme'), so the opening is incomplete.

verification.comment: The agent asked only for an order number and never confirmed the caller's full name or postcode before cancelling and sharing order details.

understanding.quote: Wait, no, I didn't want cancel all of it. I just wanted to change the to medium. That's what I meant.
understanding.comment: The agent dismissed the caller's clarified intent to change the size to medium and cancelled the whole order anyway instead of capturing the real issue.

resolution_accuracy.quote: The order hadn't been dispatched, so cancelling is free, and the €69.00 goes back to your card in 3 to 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The cancellation policy and refund timeline are stated correctly, though the cancellation itself was against the caller's stated wish to change size.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Okay, I've cancelled 903617 for the large duvet.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or bank dispute or photo step applied, so no required step was missed; yes applies because no listed process step was triggered.

communication.quote: You said cancel. It's cancelled. You'll have to order the medium again yourself.
communication.comment: The caller was panicked and the agent was curt and dismissive, never acknowledging her distress or offering to help with the change.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get a cancellation email in a few minutes. Is there anything else?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely.
